context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fixes for 3 issues: 1) DealDetails.js now has inline create-new-contact form in contact linking panel with data-testid attributes. 2) MapView.js replaced 5 fetchDeals() calls in sidebar handlers with optimistic updateDealInState() calls - only 2 fetchDeals() remain (initial load and new deal creation). 3) Added cleanup useEffect for searchTimeoutRef on unmount. All changes are frontend-only. Backend unchanged. App requires Supabase auth - no test credentials available for E2E testing.

issue_1_contact_creation.root_cause: DealDetails page only had dropdown to select existing contacts, no way to create new contacts inline
issue_1_contact_creation.fix: Added showNewContactInline state and inline form with Name/Email/Phone/Type fields, plus handleCreateAndLinkNewContact handler

issue_2_map_lag.root_cause: Every sidebar change (field edit, pipeline/stage change, image upload, visibility toggle) called fetchDeals() which refetched ALL deals and reset map state
issue_2_map_lag.fix: Replaced fetchDeals() calls with optimistic updateDealInState() that only updates the single modified deal in local state

issue_3_map_reset.root_cause: fetchDeals() was resetting viewState on every call, causing map to jump back to initial position
issue_3_map_reset.fix: Added initialLoadDone flag to only set viewState on first load, plus optimistic updates prevent unnecessary refetches
